runs.title: 晨间跑步
runs.note:
昨天睡风一般，早上并不是特别想跑。 
思忖再三还是出门了， 一边持续关注跟腱的感觉， 一边纠结4个2K 是该怎么跑步。 
每个2K 都没有拼全力， 相反都放在轻松可控制的节奏在在继续。

跑完就来康复医院做中频放松，坐在一群老年中间，显得特别的突兀。

runs.title: Easy Run
runs.note: 昨天复查了跟腱，今天开始理疗复健， 一早慢跑了一圈到了康复医院。 原来已经9月1日了， 开学日， 路上都是孩子。

runs.title: Easy Run
runs.note: 在家睡的早，也醒的早，补上周四的有氧跑。常规路线10K，因为红绿灯以及上下坡 所以并不是特别稳定。

runs.title: 晨间跑步
runs.note: 艳阳天， 调整为贡湖湾公园绕圈， 因为那里有个自饮水的点。 一出门就是晒的非常，尽量选在树荫下跑，每个公共卫生间都去把浑身打湿，居然也能轻松的基本完成了。 冰水泡了脚，怕跟腱又严重了。 今天整体感觉没压力，就是略热了点。

runs.title: AR NIGHT RUN
runs.note:
Got called out by my buddy Zhujun for an adi Runner event tonight, so I figured I’d just count it as an early recovery run.

A big group of us ran along Suzhou Creek together. The pace was really easy, but running and chatting the whole way was actually a pretty fun and refreshing way to socialize.

You’d think everyone who showed up for an event like this would be pretty extroverted. Turns out we were basically a bunch of introverts — everyone just talked to the friends they already knew.

And of course, we wrapped it up with barbecue and beer. Honestly, having nights like this every once in a while is such a great way to unwind and enjoy life.

runs.title: Race-like Run
runs.note:
I didn’t make it. That’s it.

I keep trying to find excuses whenever I fall short — it was too hot, I was thirsty, tired, the sun was too strong, something hurt… But at the end of the day, I still didn’t make it.

Last week, I fell apart in the second 5K. Today, it happened again in the second 3K…

Sigh. What are you doing, man…

runs.title: 晨间跑步
runs.note:
Today’s running rule was simple: green light, go straight; red light, turn. The whole point was to just keep moving and avoid stopping.

After wandering around for a while, I somehow ended up at Jing’an Temple. Since I was nearby, I also stopped by Xikang Road, where I used to work when I first came to Shanghai. The office building has now become an Atour Hotel, and there’s no trace of the old YOOX office anymore.

I kept going, turned another corner, and surprisingly, that Tai Huang Ji noodle shop is still there. I used to eat their chicken giblet noodles almost every single day back then.

Funny how a random run can suddenly turn into a little trip down memory lane.

runs.title: 午后跑步
runs.note:
I drove 350 km back to Wuxi this morning. After taking a nap, I still went out for this short recovery run to wrap up the week’s training on a good note.

It was windy in the evening with no harsh sun, so the pace naturally picked up a little.

Both kids are back in Wuxi now, which means summer vacation is almost over. Time really flies. Two months is enough time to do a lot, yet part of me still feels like I haven’t done enough.

Anyway, keep going. Autumn is coming. I want to grab every opportunity and possibility that comes my way, and see just how far I can push myself.

runs.title: 晨间跑步
runs.note:
I came back to my hometown, Huangshan, yesterday. I think I just wanted to come home.

On the train, I watched the green mountains, rivers, and rice fields passing by. Just before arriving, two rainbows appeared and stayed in the sky for what felt like forever. Somehow, all of it calmed a heart that had spent too long in the city.

This morning, I ran along the mountain roads. Some views are simply too beautiful to be captured by a camera. And if beautiful moments can’t last forever, then all we can do is enjoy them while they’re here.

I didn’t find anywhere to get water until 17K. Then, during the final 5K, the sun suddenly got much stronger. I could really feel the heat burning on my back.

runs.title: 晨间跑步
runs.note:
Another easy aerobic day. I didn’t want to overthink the route, so I just took the same one as Tuesday.

The first five minutes were still about getting my Achilles loosened up. Once it warmed up, things felt much better.

The weather kept switching between cloudy skies and strong sunshine. And somehow, I ran into Teacher Jiang again. What are the odds?

At this point, I can recognize him from a distance just by the way he runs. What kind of superpower is this…
